To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fluxgate magnetometer is the only type of magnetometer that can be co-integrated with the readout circuitry and is the most power-efficient and the most linear magnetic sensor IC that has been developed to date.
we have developed two ICs that co-integrate a fluxgate magnetic sensor with a readout IC on a die.

we have developed a fully integrated fluxgate magnetometer IC that achieves 20x better efficiency than the state of art, and that we have used it to realize two integrated current sensors that have the highest dynamic range, linearity, and bandwidth for their respective applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new type of magnetic field sensor based on the fluxgate principle.
the design of a magnetic fluxgate sensor and its application in a current sensing IC.
the design of integrated circuits for magnetic field sensing, with a focus on the design of the integrated fluxgate magnetometer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fluxgate magnetometer is an excellent choice for isolated current sensing applications.
this thesis work has led to the first fully integrated fluxgate magnetometer ICs that are capable of measuring isolated currents.

this paper presents two integrated fluxgate magnetometers with unprecedented performance that are co-integrated with readout circuitry and that are used to realize a fully integrated current sensing IC with 112 dB dynamic range and < 0.03% nonlinearity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a new approach for integrated fluxgate magnetometers that can be used to achieve unprecedented performance in isolated current sensing applications.
we have demonstrated the first integrated fluxgate magnetometer, and we have shown that the fluxgate magnetometer can be used for closed-loop current measurement.

we have developed a new magnetic sensor IC technology that is more than an order of magnitude more power-efficient than previous state of the art and is the first integrated sensor to achieve the dynamic range and precision required for current sensing applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a magnetic sensor can be used to realize current-sensing circuits with a dynamic range of more than 100 dB, and that a fluxgate sensor can be co-integrated along side a current sensing IC.
the fluxgate magnetometer can be used for current measurement in applications where the magnetic field is known or where the current is known.
the integrated fluxgate is a viable alternative to the Hall-effect sensor for current sensing applications.
